top_signals.title: IEA Warns of Dangerous Concentration in Global Clean Energy Supply Chains
top_signals.summary: The global energy transition depends on highly concentrated supply chains, the head of the International Energy Agency, Fatih Birol, has warned, declining to name any of the countries involved in these chains. China is by far the most dominant global player in energy transition technology, capacity, and investment. China makes the most wind and solar equipment, is the biggest battery maker in the world, and also the biggest manufacturer and seller of electric cars. According to Birol, this could be a problem, especially for Southeast Asia, Reuters…

top_signals.title: Meta’s $25 Billion Stock Sale Ended Five Times Oversubscribed
top_signals.summary: Meta Platforms Inc.’s upsized $25 billion share sale attracted demand for about five times the available shares, according to people familiar with the offering, as the company seeks to raise $98 billion for its AI spending.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
